source_image_corrections.translation:
the conclusion that the location was too central and insufficiently secure, deciding to take the being elsewhere: to Hospital Humanitas, which is much better equipped and located farther from the city center. This hospital is beside a small peripheral road leading directly to the Fernão Dias highway. In other words, this made discreet transport easier.
When Regional Hospital director Adilson Usier said on the program Fantástico that "... the hospital is not prepared to treat anything that is not human," he was doing no more than his duty. Now, we are not saying this second creature was at the hospitals to be treated. In no way. We are only saying that it passed through these places, later going to Unicamp to be analyzed by scientists. The problem is that some people underestimated our investigative ability and thought they would never arouse anyone's suspicion. Thus, we reached the conclusion that the creature removed from Humanitas was the same one seen by the three girls that afternoon.
